content: 2:1-10 In umb wogub bo der buguminei
Qoan an Qenu qob me toat, qomon boru ebet igoumon end aninomi dui wogub umau gas ende abatamanei.
Qen end an ai e wonou qomon boru eng toat qib igumanei. Ai bigau wurinou baraitari eng toat igumanei. Ai bigau see munon oau wurimenima toat igour eng Qenu qob omboarir igour.

Qoan in gugum munon yurau eng wurinob garisi igoun end qomon qoan eng toat igunei. Qomon qoan eng in misirt et igo inbumima toat igunei. Ininou ende igo ende qi eng munon boru eng wurinob garisi taui qamb uru iraminei qi.
Ego Qenu inqenungar igoar eng sig-sig mom aib end intoubarerei.

Git apand ininou qomon boru eng mom iningarama umuminei. Ego Qenu init igub igoar eng sig aib mom end Yisas munon inubersiau tari wo nob garisi bo inmenima igomot der bugaminei. End Qenu wonou qenungau end bo anmusia uber igoumon.
End Yisas munon inubersiau tari wo nob garisi inmenub ne Qenu wonou ginamt end wo nob garisi in unum irarei. End wo Qenu ii igama ne in bo Yisas ii igoruboun.
Wo eng ebeter eng munon gugum see ne qen geret wuriqenungar igoriner eng inimbig ebeterei. Wo inqenungarer eng ete: Yisas wonou sarau uber ebeter end inimbiga.
An Yisast oabigari ne Qenu anqenungar ne anqubeiamorei. Mi eng aninou maigas me ubunanei. Qenu wonou uyes mi eng anit ebeterei.
Ne gor, an sarau uber abari gab taui qamb me abau, ue. Eng gab munon ger wonou qen big yegaiar qamb me ebeiner.
Yisas ag e dara Qenu bo in munon bubun inbarsiarei. End in qomon bubun uber eng toat igoarar qamb. Wonou qoan mi eng abar qamb arsitarer end ereteri ebet igoun.
2:11-18 Munon inubersiau tari wot in munon yurau gari bureminei
An mom imbig igoumon, Yuda wurinou ubent uyes git goan suab maribig wogub anit: “munon yurau ar” qamb igour. End an musub imbigar, qoan apand aninou git goan end an munon yurau ar igumanei.

Qen end an Yisas pi me igamau. Ne gor Qenu qob nausi munon yurau wurimaribigor yurau end me igamau, an ai e munon yurau eng wurinob ag igumanei. Ende igo ne mi uber see gaumon eng an qoan qoyam ue. Ne Qenu gor me imbig igamau.
Ego see Munon inubersiau tari Yisas umor end anamar yar Qenu tenori igoarar qamb an wager end igoumon.

Munon inubersiau tari wonou oau inmeinsi ne Yuda yurau eng nob yurau ar eng nob yurau gari inmaribigorei. Qoan Yuda munon yurau ar eng nob yogub igour eng youn gas ende igoai. Igama Yisas umor end ne youn eng bapami wogub yurau ombur igour eng aba soriamirei.
Yisas wo qomon qoan igoar eng ne qob tau ne ingong tau igoar eng gugum biisiteterei. Ende ebine munon yurau ombur eng bo yurau gari burab munon yurau bubun igoarar qamb. End ne qibanamsi igoun.

Munon yurau ombur eng gab Munon inubersiau tari dara nam erer uri waramir end yogorau qomon eng bumaiamorei. Bumai wogub ne yurau ombur eng wuriba qiumunima git goan gari burari wuriqubei Qenu qani isuor end ten igour.
Munon inubersiau tari wo derer eng qob uber mein eng an munon yurau ar Qenu me imbig igoumon eng. Ne Yuda munon wo qani igour eng soro qob uber eng dibes aninob qamarei.
Igomurur werei inimbigor end in Tain wot irub qamb eng Yisas werei qo inimbigorei ereteri igo.
2:19-22 In Yisas yurau buremin end in Qenu wonou munai apand
End ne see an bo munon yogur isau gas ende ue, Qenu wonou munon yurau eng wurinob qiumuniaman end an Qenu wonou yurau apand.
In munon Yisas inimuriamor eng nob munon qob gigit qamb igour eng nob in munai qoren. Ne an munai git Qenu qoren erer end mindaterei. Ne qoren unatari eng Yisas Munon inubersiau tari eng wonou.
Mon magari qamb eng Yisas tenori big waramir end mom nautarei igo. End ne Qenu mon eng bo imusi-imusi mindat bisa mon eng aib burab ne Munon Aib wonou mon qau igoriba.
An gor Yisas tenori igoumon end Qenu munon Yisas yurau igour eng nob an qiumuniamorei. End an gugum Qenu wonou mon apand. Wonou Igomurur end anit isub igoriba.
